content: Satya pratishtayam kriya phala ashrayatvam. (When established in truthfulness, one's actions naturally yield their rightful fruits).
author: Patanjali
explanation:
In the profound psychology of the Yoga Sutras, Patanjali outlines the systematic roadmap for stilling mental fluctuations into radiant, sovereign stillness.

This teaching (Satya pratishtayam kriya phala ashrayatvam. (When establishe...) focuses directly on satya and pratishtayam. When we clear away reactive illusions and anchor ourselves in timeless principles, the mind recovers its pristine clarity and inner resilience.

True realization is never an abstract intellectual debate—it is an active discipline lived through quiet integrity and conscious presence in everyday moments.
practicalInsight: Apply this teaching on satya today: take a deliberate pause before reacting, align your actions with quiet integrity, and refuse to let transient friction disturb your center.
reflectionPrompt: How can you embody deeper satya and pratishtayam in the primary challenge you are navigating right now?
